definition.zh-TW:
損益表營業外支出區各列的合計。

課程版面底下有利息費用與攤銷遞延資產兩列；營業利益加營業外收入、減這個小計，就是經常利益。
definition.en:
The total of the lines in the non-operating expenses section of the income statement.

In the course layout it sums finance costs (interest expense) and amortisation of deferred assets; operating profit plus non-operating income minus this subtotal gives ordinary profit.

example.zh-TW: 位置：損益表營業利益之後、經常利益之前。故事裡還款付息與年底攤銷設立費之後，這一列才會有金額。現行報表把利息列在財務成本；IFRS 下設立費在發生時就列為營業費用，不會有攤銷遞延資產這一列。
example.en: Where it sits: on the income statement after operating profit and before ordinary profit. In the story it only shows an amount after the loan is repaid with interest and the start-up costs are amortised at year end. Current statements show interest under finance costs; under IFRS start-up costs are expensed as incurred within operating expenses, so there is no line for amortisation of deferred assets.

misconception.zh-TW: 把營業外支出算進營業利益。它在營業利益之後才扣，所以利息多寡不影響營業利益，只影響經常利益以下的各層。
misconception.en: Deducting non-operating expenses before operating profit. They come after it, so the size of the interest bill leaves operating profit untouched and only affects ordinary profit and the levels below.

formula.zh-TW: 營業外支出小計 ＝ 利息費用 ＋ 攤銷遞延資產。
formula.en: Total non-operating expenses = finance costs (interest expense) + amortisation of deferred assets.
